__comment__: all_ops and all_tasks must be has, and do not modify. user can define custom run op list for test if not want run all ops.
__hardware_bug_comment__: 1.arange: int64-to-bf16 when value gt 256. 2.cross_entropy_loss/vector_norm/mse_loss: fp16 reduce_sum cannot return inf. 3.to_dtype: fp32-to-int16/int32/int64 when value gt max(dtype(int16/32/64)). 4.floor_divide: float-point round modes differ. 5.index_put_: bf16 atomic_add accumulate exceeds accuracy. 6.pad: fp32-trunc-to-bf16 behavior inconsistent with CPU. 7.weight_norm: flaggems triton kernel implements bugs. 8.isin/unique/sort/quantile/conv2d/upsample: too time-consuming.
